description: List the mods for a game updated within a recent window (1d / 1w / 1m), newest first, up to 100, with how many there are in all. Each comes with its mod_id, name, version and when it was updated: the feed a load-order maintainer watches to know what to refresh. No Nexus key needed.

game_domain.description: The game's domain name (e.g. 'skyrimspecialedition'). Use nexus_list_games to find these.

name: nexus_updated
title: Nexus mods updated recently
